# {{ site.title }}

> Senior Software Engineer specialized in Ruby on Rails and React, backed by solid Java experience, with 15+ years building production systems and a rigorous AI-assisted engineering workflow. Moving toward Elixir/Phoenix LiveView.

Maykell Sánchez Romero is a Senior Software Engineer based in Ecuador (UTC-5, within 1 hour of US Eastern time), open to remote roles, who builds products end to end (data model, backend, interface, background processing and reports) and practices AI-assisted software engineering with LLMs (Claude Code, Codex). AI workflow: sets the architecture, design principles and tools; specifies each feature with expected results, examples and counterexamples; reviews and stores the agent's plan before coding; implements point by point with traceability and a review at each checkpoint; reviews the code personally plus a cross-review by a second, different agent; and requires new tests, the full test suite, linters, formatters and a security agent before staging and QA. Repeated problems become project rules and repeated tasks become agent skills (details: {{ '/how-i-work/' | absolute_url }}). Current focus: agentic software engineering for fast system development with accountability, and distributed systems architecture for fast, scalable, resilient, maintainable solutions.
